title: A study on RSVPreF3 vaccine in adults aged ≥ 60 years
official: Real-World Effectiveness of the Adjuvanted RSVPreF3 Vaccine in Adults ≥60 Years: A Pragmatic Randomized Trial (BronquiVal)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effectiveness of the RSVPreF3 vaccine (Arexvy®, GSK) in reducing RSV-related respiratory disease (RD) hospitalisations among individuals aged ≥ 60 years in the Valencian Community in Spain.
conditions: Respiratory syncytial virus infection–related respiratory disease

interventions.name: Arexvy powder and suspension for suspension for injection Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) vaccine (recombinant, adjuvanted)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants aged ≥ 60 years.
2. Participants resident of the Valencian Community.
3. Informed consent form has been signed and dated.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Contraindication of the vaccine: hypersensitivity to any of the components of the vaccine.
2. Previous vaccination with any RSV vaccine.
3. Participation in any other clinical trial (including for Medicines and Treatments) during the study period.
4. The following individuals will be excluded from the study, as RSV vaccination is already recommended for these groups in the region: • Adults aged 60 years or older living in long-term care or nursing home facilities.  • Individuals with a history of lung transplantation.  • Individuals with a history of haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (bone marrow transplantation).
sponsor: Fundacion Para El Fomento De La Investigacion Sanitaria Y Biomedica De La Comunitat Valenciana
